items: A new table on the Console page, "Tokens per agent (last 30 days)": for each agent, runs, calls, input, output, cache read, cache write, total and model. It comes from the transcripts Claude Code keeps for each helper agent; each model answer is counted once (the same answer is written on several lines with growing counts).
Honest by design: if the transcripts are not on this computer the table says "not available", never zero. Counts only, no prices. The main session stays in the tokens box above.
Read once and cached in `Claude/logs/agent-costs-cache.json`; later openings only read new runs. Works in both console servers.
